text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Thanks for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm working on a project in 
collaboration with the Academy. So I'll be 
coming around here for a while.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Even so, this town really hasn't changed. 
It's the exact same view as when I was a 
student...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm a working adult now...! Even 
that fancy French lunch I used to dream 
about...! Now that I'm all grown up, I can 
actually go...!!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh!? J-Just kidding! I-I'll do my 
best to work diligently!"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Still, if you have a free day sometime, 
would you care to join me? I'm, uh... 
currently looking for a lunch buddy.
